reason: council-remediation-2026-07-20 agent-R: original question asked for institutional hospital Occupancy Group classification, which is off-scope for a Group A dwellings article (Rule VII Sec. 708 + Rule VIII Sec. 805-811). Replaced with a Sec. 807 air-space-per-person question directly supported by the article.

source_audit_support.citation: PD 1096 2004 Revised IRR, Rule VIII, Section 807

proposed.text: Under PD 1096 Rule VIII Section 807, what is the minimum air space required per occupant of a habitable room in a Group A dwelling?

options.text: 10.00 cubic meters of air space per occupant
12.00 cubic meters of air space per occupant
14.00 cubic meters of air space per occupant
9.00 cubic meters of air space per occupant

proposed.rationale: Section 807 requires at least 14.00 cubic meters of air space per occupant in habitable rooms of Group A dwellings. Combined with the minimum ceiling height from Section 805, this sets a floor-area-per-person baseline for the room.
proposed.explanation: Worked example: a room with a 2.70 m ceiling housing 2 persons needs 2 x 14.00 = 28.00 cu.m, which at 2.70 m height requires 28.00 / 2.70 = 10.37 sq.m of floor area. The 14.00 cu.m value is the per-person constant; the floor-area translation depends on ceiling height.
